# SHAD experiment registry

All 215 series of SHAD, grouped by scenario. Browse them interactively in the [explorer](https://scality.github.io/shad/explorer.html).
*Generated by `Scripts/build_site_data.py` from the XML annotations and CSV labels.*

Columns: **Start** = first timestamp (UTC), **Len.** = number of timestamps, **Anom.** = fraction of anomalous timestamps, **Dims** = number of labelled dimensions.
